Danielle Tran: Quick postmortem follow-up on the midnight eviction pattern. Need owners for runbook edits, an alert, and an RFC for gating bulk jobs. Keep it minimal.
Josh Patel: I can own the runbook/playbook edits. Will add a one-page oncall cheatsheet + pasteable triage commands by Tue COB.
Josh Patel: Proposed triage snippets to include:
```bash
# check node and pod memory hotspots
kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -nr
kubectl top pods -n inference | grep -E 'kv-cache|redis'
# tail cache logs for errors
kubectl logs -n inference deploy/kv-cache --since=15m --tail=200
# quick metric check (Prometheus)
curl -s 'http://prometheus.monitoring/api/v1/query?query=sum(increase(redis_evicted_keys_total[5m]))' | jq .data.result
```
Mira Alvarez: I'll own the Grafana/Prometheus recurring-pattern alert. Plan: warning at 6 evictions/5m, critical at 20 evictions/5m aggregated across cache pods. Draft rule by Fri.
monitor-bot: Created ticket INC-2999: "Runbook + alerting for nightly eviction spikes" assigned to Josh Patel, due 2026-04-12.
Danielle Tran: Immediate mitigations to document: reduce route batch_size, rotate cache pods, and fail over heavy routes to smaller variants. Example commands in the playbook: 
```bash
# reduce batch size via API
redwood config set --route "/v1/generate" --batch_size 6 --reason 'mitigation'
# rotate cache pods
kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-cache -n inference
# failover route to smaller variant
redwood route set --route "/v1/generate" --variant small --reason 'eviction-mitigation'
```
Oncall Bot: INC-2999 updated with owners and due dates.
Josh Patel: I'll also add an "Escalation" section: infra-oncall -> platform-eng -> SRE lead, include Slack handles and pager numbers.
Mira Alvarez: I'll add a dashboard panel showing eviction rate by job window and a 2-step alert (warning->critical). Will ping Josh for dashboard copy.
Danielle Tran: Owners summary (please paste into INC-2999): runbook/playbook: Josh Patel — due 2026-03-31; alert/dashboard: Mira Alvarez — due 2026-04-02; RFC for job gating/staggering: Danielle Tran — draft due 2026-04-09; runbook review + merge: Josh + Mira — review by 2026-03-30. Action items: include pasteable commands above, add health-check gating for nightly jobs, and document explicit page order.
Josh Patel: ack :thumbsup: I'll post the PR with cheatsheet and minimal steps so oncall can act quickly.
Mira Alvarez: Ack. Happy to pair on thresholds if helpful.
Danielle Tran: Thanks — I'll follow up next week and mark blockers in INC-2999."
